title: Unify Agent Instruction Files
description: Setup main AGENTS.md as the single canonical instruction file, replace derived root files such as CLAUDE.md and GEMINI.md with symlinks to AGENTS.md, and set up git so symlinks work cross-platform on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
summary: Canonicalized root agent instructions in AGENTS.md, added cross-platform git setup with repo hook configuration plus alias recreation, and collapsed CLAUDE.md/GEMINI.md onto AGENTS.md via link setup with restricted-Windows hard-link fallback.
